newsitem.title: USA: Lindsay sees FY97 revenue up about 15 pct.
newsitem.headline: Lindsay sees FY97 revenue up about 15 pct.

text.p: Lindsay Manufacturing Co said Thursday it expects total revenue growth for fiscal 1997 to be near the lower end of the 15 to 20 percent range previously cited.

"For the full year, total revenue growth should be close to the lower end of the 15 to 20 percent range previously cited, with North American irrigation equipment, export irrigation equipment and diversified products each contributing to the growth," Gary Parker, chairman, said in a statement.

He added that, for fiscal 1997, Lindsay remains confident it will meet or exceed its annual financial goals, although it may be difficult for North American irrigation equipment to match last year's strong fourth quarter.
Lindsay's goals are for average annual sales growth of five to 10 percent, gross margins of 22 to 24 percent, operating margins of 10 to 13 percent and return on beginning equity of 20 to 25 percent.

"...North American irrigation equipment revenues are typically at their lowest activity level in our fourth quarter and can vary significantly from year to year depending on weather patterns during the quarter," Parker said. "Last year's fourth-quarter North American irrigation equipment revenues benefited from favorable weather conditions and could be hard to match in fiscal 1997."
Earlier, Lindsay reported earnings for the third quarter ended May 31 of $0.61 a share, up from $0.56 a year ago, adjusted for a March 1997 three-for-two stock split.

The company said an approximate doubling of export sales and a 45 percent jump in diversified products revenue more than offset a 17 percent decline in North American irrigation equipment revenue during the quarter.
Third-quarter gross margin improved to 27.1 percent from 25.8 percent a year ago largely due to price increases initiated during the quarter, Lindsay said.
At May 31, 1997, Lindsay's order backlog was $16.2 million versus $16.3 million posted in the year-ago period.
